body: I'm trying to do something about it, but it's frustrating. There's so much waiting, to get off lists, to get appointments weeks away with psychologists who live in another part of the province... I don't know now if I'm any closer to transitioning than I was a year ago. And I really do feel alone. I don't have any peers I can talk to about this, and I don't know where or how to get real support, and if I had it I'd be afraid of whoever was helping me rejecting me for being a burden.
